testcase.name: Scenario: Decline removal of duplicate model-state member names: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:1386:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Decline removal of duplicate model-state member names ✔ Given The MCAD Software has a model-state table with members Capture State and Model State1 ✔ When the user changes the Model State1 member cell to "Capture State" and presses Enter ✔ Then both matching member-name cells are highlighted yellow ✔ And OK is enabled ✔ When the user selects OK ✔ Then a warning identifies the duplicate name and says duplicates will be removed if the user continues ✔ And the warning offers Yes and No ✔ When the user selects No ✔ Then the table remains open with both duplicate names highlighted ✔ When the user cancels the table ✔ Then the table closes without accepting the rename
